key_insight: CAST represents 3D shapes as paired top and bottom depth images, excluding undercuts along a selected mold-opening direction by construction.
engineering_relevance: A shared representation connects generative shape exploration with FEA-guided structural refinement while preserving the selected pull-direction restriction.
method: Encode geometry as paired depth images defining one material interval along each pull-direction ray.
Train diffusion models to generate candidate shapes in this representation.
Refine both depth boundaries using FEA-guided optimization with a volume penalty.
evidence_signal: Using 211 SimJEB training designs, refinement reduced compliance in 193 of 200 generated candidates, with a 36.8% median reduction across all candidates in the optimization FEA model.
watch_item: Undercut exclusion applies only to the selected pull direction; reconstructing existing shapes can fill occluded regions and increase material volume.
paper_title: CAST: Cast-Admissible Generative Design and Shape Optimization with Paired Depth Images
